name: Cognitive Friction
axiom: Interfaces create friction when reaching a goal takes more or different actions than people expect.
trigger: Users click a search icon, wait for the overlay, then click the field again before they can type.
checklist: Let Enter submit single-field forms such as search and sign-in.
Move focus into the primary input as soon as a dialog opens.
Keep Tab, Shift+Tab, and arrow keys working through every menu.

antiPattern.violation: Opening search means clicking the icon, waiting for the overlay, and clicking the field before typing.
antiPattern.remediation: Bind search to a keyboard shortcut that opens the dialog already focused on its input.

academicOrigin.title: The Inmates Are Running the Asylum
